query:
SELECT 
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wow_report_json, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')) IS NULL as is_null,
  LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wow_report_json, '$.lifeHistoryPattern'))) as length,
  LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wow_report_json, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 200) as preview
FROM analysis_reports ar
JOIN client_profiles cp ON ar.client_profile_id = cp.id
JOIN users u ON cp.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Amanda%' OR u.email LIKE '%amanda%'
LIMIT 1;
